items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: They always come where I was. And I'd go somewhere and I'd look up and the first thing I'd see would be him and his wife.

ctx.x: Yeah and you know Mr. Panassie said one time, when ever I come over there he and his wife . .

Yes. They always come where I was. And I'd go somewhere and I'd look up and the first thing I'd see would be him and his wife. And he said, 'you know Helen I just can't understand it. It just seems like these people just love you so and they don't never want you to stop singing.' He said, 'even the younger people.
